title: Customer-centric reranker evaluation: per-promptset NDCG/MRR pipeline and A/B hooks
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an instrumentation and evaluation pipeline that produces per-customer and per-promptset NDCG@10 and MRR tracking for reranking endpoints, exposes A/B test hooks for live experiments, and ties quality metrics to rollout policies in the Console.
background: Customers have reported inconsistencies in reranker quality across different prompt sets and traffic slices. Existing evals are batch-oriented and not tied to live A/B traffic or the Console rollout logic. This ticket bridges evaluation telemetry (NDCG/MRR) with live experiment flags and per-customer promptset attribution.
goals: Emit per-request eval signals (label, score, rank position) for downstream NDCG/MRR computation
Associate each request with a customer promptset id and evaluation version
Support lightweight online A/B hooks that mark requests for experiment cohorts without adding >2ms p95 latency
Surface NDCG@10 and MRR rollup in Console with filter by customer, promptset, model, and experiment
success_metrics: Automated pipelines compute daily NDCG@10 and MRR per promptset for 95% of active customers
End-to-end p95 request overhead from adding eval tags and experiment headers < 2ms
Can run online A/B experiments with consistent metric drift detection (alerts when delta > 1.5% and p < 0.05)
Console shows promptset-level trend charts with 90-day retention
instrumentation_plan: Server-side: attach eval metadata to rerank responses (fields: promptset_id, eval_version, gold_label_present, chosen_rank, scores_array)
Telemetry: emit a compact eval event to telemetry pipeline (labelled 'rerank.eval') asynchronously via existing batcher
Storage: store raw eval events in eval-events-s3 prefix partitioned by date/customer/promptset
Aggregation: weekly/rolling NDCG and MRR compute job (Spark) that writes rollups to metrics-store and Console mirror index
Schema: new telemetry schema version v2 for rerank.eval (documented in Confluence)
ab_testing_hooks: Add an experiment header (X-Rdwr-Exp) to requests which the router will set based on rollout policy
Sampler: default 1% lightweight deterministic hashing on request_id for holdout vs treatment; override by rollout rules
Evaluation tagging: event includes experiment_id and cohort label so rollups can slice by experiment
Automatic fallback: if experiment cohort triggers a variant with incompatible model, tag event and route to fallback model and mark as 'incompatible_variant'
rerank_promptset_pipeline: Create ingestion API for customer prompt sets: validation, normalization, and canonicalization of labels
Map promptset versions to eval_version tags; support backfills and historical mapping
Provide a lightweight UI in Console for customers to upload a labeled promptset for private evals (future work, initial API only)
Retention policy: keep raw labeled promptset snapshots for 180 days
tasks: Design telemetry schema and get sign-off from Observability (owner: Rohan)
Implement server-side tagging in rerank handler and ensure async emission (owner: Priya S.)
Add router header logic for experiment cohort selection (owner: Kenji T.)
Build nightly Spark job to compute NDCG@10/MRR and expose via metrics-store (owner: DataEng team)
Console: wire up new rollup endpoints and add filter controls for promptset and experiment (owner: Product Eng)
Integration tests: synthetic runs using customer-like promptsets and end-to-end checks for metrics correctness (owner: QA)
Run a 2-week internal canary with sample customers before broad rollout (owner: Rohan)
Document schema, API, and runbook in Confluence and update incident playbooks
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry events including promptset_id and experiment fields are being emitted for >=95% of rerank requests in canary
Daily rollup job produces stable NDCG@10 and MRR values matching offline baseline within 0.5%
A/B experiment slicing is available in Console for the canary cohort and delta detection alerts fire on significant regressions
End-to-end p95 latency overhead for tagged rerank requests is measured and < 2ms compared to baseline
risks: Extra telemetry churn could increase storage costs and downstream processing time
Incorrect label attribution from customer-uploaded promptsets could poison rollups if not validated
Experiment hooks might be applied inconsistently across edge routers without careful rollout
Aggregation job edge cases for small promptsets (n<5) could produce unstable NDCG/MRR — need guardrails
dependencies_notes: Depends on schema changes in ENG-64720 (telemetry v2) and new routing header support in ENG-65111. Coordinate with DataEng for Spark resources and Observability for dashboard plumbing.
